items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...How was your Ray Hardy with those guys? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm.

ctx.x: Mr. Bobby Lack and Red Naked. How was your Ray Hardy with those guys? Was he… did he compare at all, or do you remember? Well, he did. He played more than the style of Lloyd.
